test_title: PYST 9: SSC CPO - Reasoning(Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Q is to the east of S. E is to the south of S. P is to the north-east of Q and north of T. If T is to the south-east of Q, what is the position of S with respect to T? (All positions are arranged in GRID pattern)
solution:
As per the given information:

Q is to the east of S and E is to the south of S. 

P is to the north-east of Q and north of T and T is to the south-east of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59bb62e19b0ac58a5db9c83e94b7cf684d42b4d6c9e273bd4273c39e8c7f2669.png] 

Clearly, S is in the north-west direction from T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
